rules.title: Atal Setu sea link: two-wheelers not allowed
rules.detail: Two-wheelers, three-wheelers, cycles and animal carts may not enter the Sewri to Nhava Sheva sea link out of Mumbai.

source.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Atal Bihari Vajpayee Sewri Nhava Sheva Atal Setu

history.change: Sea link opened to traffic, with two-wheelers and three-wheelers barred from the start.

source.title: Mumbai Trans Harbour Link

rules.title: Pune district: monsoon orders shut waterfalls and dams
rules.detail: Each monsoon the district bars entry to waterfalls, dams and viewpoints around Lonavala, Mulshi, Tamhini and Malshej. The orders cover the spots, not travel on the road.
rules.set_by: District Collector, Pune, and sub-divisional officers

source.title: After Lonavala waterfall tragedy, prohibitory orders imposed at picnic spots in Maharashtra's Pune

history.change: Collector barred entry to Bhushi dam, Lonavala, Mulshi dam, Tamhini Ghat, Malshej Ghat and other spots under the Disaster Management Act.

source.title: Monsoon: Pune Collector bans entry to Lonavala, Tamhini ghat, Bhushi, Mulshi dam and other places

history.change: After five drowned near Bhushi dam, the Collector barred visits to tourist spots in Lonavala and Mulshi after 6 pm.

source.title: Pune District Collector Enforces Strict Tourism Ban After 6 PM in Lonavala and Mulshi Following Tragic Incident

history.change: Prohibitory orders until 31 July 2024 at Bhushi dam, Tiger Point, Lion's Point, Mulshi dam, Tamhini Ghat, Malshej Ghat and others.

source.title: After Lonavala waterfall tragedy, prohibitory orders imposed at picnic spots in Maharashtra's Pune

history.change: Sub-divisional officer for Maval and Mulshi withdrew the orders as rain and dam releases eased.

source.title: Good News for Punekars: Ban on Tourist Places Lifted from Lonavla to Tamhini in District

history.change: Sub-divisional officer barred vehicles, two-wheelers included, from the vicinity of waterfalls, dams and riverbanks at Malshej Ghat, Bhimashankar and other spots.

source.title: Pune: Entry Curbs Imposed At Bhimashankar, Malshej Ghat and Other Tourist Spots Amid Heavy Rain

rules.title: Panchgani and Mahabaleshwar: entry and pollution tax
rules.detail: Panchgani's council collects entry and pollution tax at the Dandegar checkpost; vehicles only passing through to Mahabaleshwar are not meant to pay. Reports do not mention two-wheelers.

source.title: Tourists Raise Questions Over Toll Collection On Mahabaleshwar Route Via Panchgani

history.change: The two councils asked the state to bar tourists' private vehicles and allow only electric ones. No decision was reported.

source.title: Ban Private Vehicles Of Tourists In Mahabaleshwar, Panchgani: Municipal Council To Government

history.change: After complaints, the council's chief officer said collectors were told not to charge vehicles heading straight to Mahabaleshwar.

source.title: Tourists Raise Questions Over Toll Collection On Mahabaleshwar Route Via Panchgani

rules.title: Malshej Ghat in monsoon: ride through, no stopping
rules.detail: A travel company's 2026 summary says through traffic is allowed but stopping on the ghat road and entering the main waterfalls is barred. The order itself was not read.

source.title: Monsoon Trekking Rules 2026: Banned Waterfalls, Dams and Fort Treks by State

rules.title: Tamhini sanctuary side routes shut in monsoon
rules.detail: A travel company's 2026 summary says Raigad district shut six side routes in the Tamhini sanctuary from 1 July to 30 September 2026. The order itself was not read.

source.title: Monsoon Trekking Rules 2026: Banned Waterfalls, Dams and Fort Treks by State

season.note: The ghats are driest and clearest from October to December; July brings the heaviest rain and the yearly orders that shut waterfalls, dams and viewpoints.

history.note: Tourist spots, not roads, were shut until 31 July 2024. The order for Maval and Mulshi was withdrawn on 1 August 2024.

gaps: No official page was read for the two-wheeler rule on the Mumbai to Pune Expressway; the Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation site failed with an expired certificate.
Whether two-wheelers may use the short ghat stretch near Khandala where the old highway joins the expressway, and how the May 2026 bypass changed this, was not sourced.
The text of the 2026 Pune district order for Lonavala was not found; a travel company gives its dates as 6 to 31 July 2026.
No source found for a monsoon closure order at Mahabaleshwar. No official page was found for the entry and pollution tax, or for whether two-wheelers pay it, so amounts are left out.
No source found for the altitude of Tamhini Ghat or Malshej Ghat, or for fog on the ghats.
Usual number of riding days: no source found.
The highway value combines Wikipedia pages for National Highway 48 and 61; only one is cited.
Videos: the pages give upload dates, not filming dates, so 'filmed' is filled only where the title names a date. Uploads, in order: 2025-11, 2021-07.
